title: Large Classification-Risk-Optional Label Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2609.06873v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study how a limited labeling budget should be allocated to minimize multiclass zero-one classification risk. We consider parametric classification problems in which features are observed for all sampling units while class labels can be acquired selectively. By combining the Fisher information supplied by an acquired label with the local geometry of multiclass excess risk, we derive an acquisition criterion that minimizes the leading asymptotic coefficient of expected multiclass excess risk. The resulting rule values a label according to how strongly its information is aligned with parameter directions that perturb the active Bayes decision boundary, rather than according to posterior uncertainty or global parameter information alone. We characterize the oracle acquisition design, establish its threshold structure, and derive face-specific and cost-sensitive extensions. translated_title: 大规模分类风险最优的标签获取
translated_abstract: 我们研究在有限标注预算下应如何进行分配，以最小化多分类的0-1分类风险。我们考虑参数化分类问题，其中所有抽样单元的特征均可被观测，而类别标签可以有选择地获取。通过将所获取标签提供的Fisher信息与多分类超额风险的局部几何结构相结合，我们推导出一个标签获取准则，该准则可最小化期望多分类超额风险的领先渐近系数。由此得到的规则依据标签信息与扰动当前贝叶斯决策边界的参数方向的对齐程度来评估标签的价值，而非仅依据后验不确定性或全局参数信息。我们刻画了最优获取设计，建立了其阈值结构，并推导了面向特定情形以及代价敏感的扩展。一个解析示例表明，后验不确定性与分类……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种融合Fisher信息与多分类超额风险局部几何结构的标签获取准则，通过衡量标签信息与扰动贝叶斯决策边界的参数方向的对齐程度来最优分配有限标注预算，从而最小化渐近分类风险。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an optimal label acquisition criterion that combines Fisher information with the local geometry of multiclass excess risk, valuing labels by their alignment with parameter directions perturbing the active Bayes decision boundary so as to optimally allocate a limited labeling budget and minimize asymptotic classification risk.
